_doc: World treks (generated by tools/trails/world_tail.py from OpenStreetMap, ODbL, and the Copernicus DEM; never edit by hand). geo.enc: encoded polyline of lat, lon, metres.

trails.name: Ammassalik Long Circuit
trails.why: Mostly no trail visible. Long circuit includes 39 km by boat.

trails.name: Klosterdalen - Tupaasaat - Qinndalen Trail
trails.why: Trekking with no or little trail-visibility. For Tupaassat and Qinngua Valey no GPS-trace available

trails.name: UFO Trail
trails.why: A long day hike to a unique backcountry hut overlooking the spectacular 1st fjord north of Sisimiut.

trails.name: Oqummiannguaq Trail
trails.why: The trail is mostly obvious and follows ATV tracks for quite a lot of its length. River crossings may be tricky early in season

trails.name: Oqummiannguaq Trail Return
trails.why: A full day hike around the isolated mountain of Oqummiannguaq. Much easier than most other hiking trails near Sisimiut with river and valley views.

trails.name: Qaqqarsuaq summit near Qaqortoq
trails.why: Qaqqarsuaq is a mountain in Greenland at 685 m. It is located at; it belongs to the municipality of Kujalleq.

trails.name: Palasip Qaqqaa summit
trails.why: Palasip Qaqqaa is a 544-metre-high mountain in the Qeqqata municipality in western Greenland.
